t: The Simon Says System: Empowering LLMs with Visual UI Guidance
s: This article details the development of a 'Simon Says MCP UI Flash System' that enables LLMs to guide users through web interfaces by visually highlighting UI elements. It addresses challenges in LLM interaction, MCP protocol, and real-time UI feedback.
sub: MCP (Model Control Protocol) for LLM tool calls
Real-time UI element flashing via WebSockets
LLM prompt engineering for UI guidance tasks
Debugging LLM tool execution with specific response formats
Pipulate framework transparency in MCP architecture
